title: delphiPalettes 0.0.0.9000
text: delphi_palette() gains direction argument reverse color order defaults first palette. print_delphi_palette() draws selected palette returns colors invisibly. delphi_palette() now errors type = "continuous" requested without n, instead silently returning discrete palette unchanged. delphi_palette() now applies direction full palette subsetting n, n colors direction = -1 last n colors original order, reversed (previously first n colors selected, reversed). delphi_palette(type = "continuous") now preserves alpha channel interpolating palettes use 8-digit hex colors (e.g. "glassmorphism"), instead silently dropping . New delphi_palette_colorblind() reports whether palette colorblind-friendly (every color pair distinguishable original palette stays distinguishable simulated deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia), determined ‘colorblindcheck’ package. delphi_palettes() gains colorblind_friendly argument filter collection colorblind-friendly palettes, combinable category. New print_delphi_palettes() draws grid palette swatches browsing collection, subset filtered category /colorblind_friendly, glance. New ggplot2 scales: scale_color_delphi_d() / scale_fill_delphi_d() discrete data (extending palette interpolation levels colors) scale_color_delphi_c() / scale_fill_delphi_c() continuous data, scale_colour_*() aliases. ggplot2 ‘Suggests’ dependency, required scales used.
